snippet.title: [New Game] "Doraemon Comic Traveler" Release Commemorative PV
snippet.description:
The game service G123 has launched "Doraemon Comic Traveler"!

Start playing the game here:https://s.g123.jp/71o0w3s1

"Doraemon Comic Traveler" is a full-fledged online RPG where you go on an adventure on the new planet "Comic Planet" together with the beloved national characters Doraemon, Nobita, and their friends. On Comic Planet, the residents known as "Comic Aliens" are skilled at transforming, and you can play together with them as they transform into characters from "Doraemon: The Long Story".

Additionally, a key feature of titles available on G123 is that you can start playing immediately on your web browser without needing to install an app.

■ Basic Game Info
Title: Doraemon Comic Traveler
Genre: Full-scale Online RPG
Price: Free (with optional in-game purchases)
